clue.text: Oral agreement for a rise

indicators.note: oral means spoken, so the word for agreement is heard rather than seen

parts.note: assent is agreement or consent

explanation.surface: A spoken deal reached so that someone gets a pay rise.
explanation.definitionFit: A climb upward is a rise, as in the ascent of a mountain.

clue.text: Renovated local tea place

indicators.note: renovated means done up and remade, so the letters of these words are reworked

explanation.surface: A refurbished neighbourhood tearoom.
explanation.definitionFit: To allocate is to assign or put something in its position.

clue.text: Calm artfully created

definitions.meaning: written or put together, as a piece of music is

explanation.definitionFit: Composed means serene in manner, and also written or arranged, as a symphony is.

clue.text: Catch or fastener

definitions.meaning: to ... a criminal is to catch them
a metal pin hammered into wood

explanation.definitionFit: To collar a culprit is slang for this verb; the noun is a metal spike driven into timber.

clue.text: Works of poets are broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast also means scattered widely, so the letters of these words are scattered and regrouped

explanation.surface: Poems by various writers go out on the radio.
explanation.definitionFit: A machine that operates is one that functions or runs.

clue.text: Take big risk with intense drama

parts.note: a play is a drama for the stage
fire is intense passion or ardour

explanation.surface: A gambler stakes a lot on a gripping stage show.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to court danger by recklessly tempting fate.

clue.text: Call used in boxing

definitions.meaning: the roped square where boxers fight

explanation.definitionFit: To phone someone is this verb, and the roped arena for a bout is the noun.

clue.text: Combine to get side promoted

parts.note: a side is a team in sport
up as in moved up a division

explanation.surface: A club joins forces to win promotion to a higher league.
explanation.definitionFit: Joining forces with someone is a phrasal-verb synonym for combine.

clue.text: Last of the late-comers gets rotten seat

indicators.note: the final letter of the word late-comers is taken

parts.note: addle, as in an addle egg, means rotten

explanation.surface: Whoever arrives last ends up with the broken chair.
explanation.walkthrough: ADDLE as an adjective (an addle egg) is old-fashioned for rotten or spoilt.
explanation.definitionFit: A rider sits in a saddle, the seat strapped to a horse or bicycle.

clue.text: The little devil breaks cover and gets clear

indicators.note: the imp breaks into the cover, splitting it open around itself

parts.note: a lid is a cover
an imp is a small mischievous devil

explanation.surface: A mischievous sprite escapes from hiding and gets away.
explanation.definitionFit: Limpid water is transparent, like a clear pool.

clue.text: Sea and shore — or just the shore

parts.note: the main is a poetic word for the open sea
land as opposed to the sea

explanation.surface: A comment on what you see at the coast: sea and beach, or only the beach.
explanation.walkthrough: The main is literary for the ocean (the Spanish Main).
explanation.definitionFit: A continent's principal landmass, not its islands, is land alone without sea.

clue.text: Nothing is gained when advances are made thus

definitions.text: Nothing is gained when advances are made thus

parts.words: Nothing is gained when advances are made thus
parts.note: advances here are loans, and nothing gained means the lender earns no charge on them

explanation.surface: A gloomy proverb that progress brings no reward.
explanation.definitionFit: A loan with no charge for borrowing earns the lender nothing extra.

clue.text: Whip cut

definitions.meaning: a riding ... is a short whip
to ... hair is to cut it short

explanation.definitionFit: A rider's short whip is a crop, and to trim closely is also to crop.

clue.text: Split asunder

definitions.meaning: divided into a pair of parts

explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe something broken into a pair of halves.

clue.text: Far from friendly point-to-point meeting?

parts.note: a point-to-point is a horse race, but here the points are sword tips meeting in a hostile fight

explanation.surface: A rough day out at a country horse race.
explanation.walkthrough: A point-to-point is a British amateur steeplechase; here the points are the tips of swords.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal fight between a pair of swordsmen is far from friendly.

clue.text: A bar erected on quarter deck

indicators.note: in a down clue, erected means set upright, so the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a rod is a bar
N, north, is a quarter of the compass

explanation.surface: A railing is put up on part of a ship's deck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'erected' turns ROD upward to DOR in this down clue; 'quarter deck' looks like a ship's quarterdeck, but deck is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To deck out a room is to decorate or embellish it.

clue.text: "Stretch" or "bird"

definitions.meaning: to strain the neck to see

explanation.definitionFit: Craning your neck is stretching it, and the heron-like wader is the bird.

clue.text: Leading stylists of today

parts.note: people at the front of current fashion whom others copy

explanation.surface: The top hairdressers working now.
explanation.definitionFit: Those who start fashions that others follow lead modern style.

clue.text: Wait a minute, the tea is brewing

indicators.note: brewing tea stirs and steeps it, so the letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone asks for a moment's patience while the pot of tea stews.
explanation.definitionFit: To pause in doubt before acting is to delay briefly.

clue.text: One naturally separated from the rest of humanity

definitions.text: One naturally separated from the rest of humanity

parts.words: One naturally separated from the rest of humanity
parts.note: naturally hints at geography: someone cut off by the sea rather than by temperament

explanation.surface: A born loner who keeps apart from society.
explanation.definitionFit: A resident of an isle is cut off by water from the mainland population.

clue.text: Colourful digits useful in the nursery

parts.note: green is a colour
fingers are digits

explanation.surface: Bright painted hands help in a children's playroom.
explanation.walkthrough: The nursery is a plant nursery, not a children's room; the phrase means a knack for gardening.
explanation.definitionFit: A talent for growing plants is valuable where seedlings are raised.

clue.text: Music of the twenties

definitions.meaning: a score is a set of twenty

explanation.definitionFit: Written orchestral music is a score, and a score also counts twenty, so several are twenties.

clue.text: Road in centre of south African frontier

indicators.note: the abbreviation goes into the middle of the other word

parts.note: a Boer is a South African of Dutch descent

explanation.surface: A highway crossing the middle of South Africa's national boundary.
explanation.definitionFit: A boundary between countries is a frontier.

clue.text: Stupid person makes cold soup

indicators.note: a soup mixes things up, so the letters of the word cold are jumbled

explanation.surface: A fool serves gazpacho.
explanation.definitionFit: A dolt or blockhead is a slow-witted individual.

clue.text: Navigational aids for sailor on ship

indicators.note: a sailor on a ship is aboard, contained within the vessel

parts.note: SS stands for steamship
a tar is a seaman

explanation.surface: A seaman aboard needs instruments to find the way.
explanation.definitionFit: Sailors steered by the heavenly bodies at night.

clue.text: Roman road goes round southern pass

indicators.note: the road encircles the letter, holding it inside

parts.note: via is Latin for road

explanation.surface: An old Roman highway winds round a mountain pass to the south.
explanation.definitionFit: A visa is an official permit to enter a country, like a travel pass.

clue.text: Block the way to work?

parts.note: St, street, is a way
op, opus, is a work

explanation.surface: Obstructing the route someone takes to the office.
explanation.definitionFit: To halt or obstruct something is to block it.

clue.text: I love getting a thank-you letter

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, written O
ta is informal British for thank you

explanation.surface: I'm delighted to receive a note of thanks.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the ninth character of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Bird of colourful origin

parts.note: red is a colour
a start is an origin or beginning

explanation.surface: A bird that came from bright beginnings.
explanation.definitionFit: A small songbird with a rusty-orange tail is a type of bird.

clue.text: Animal on a road is easily frightened

definitions.note: a descriptive phrase standing for a noun: one who is easily frightened

parts.note: a cow is an animal

explanation.surface: A beast standing on the highway is skittish.
explanation.definitionFit: A person lacking courage is quick to take fright.

clue.text: One taking coat off — and the rest!

definitions.text: One taking coat off — and the rest!

parts.words: One taking coat off — and the rest!
parts.note: a coat here may be paint removed by a solvent, or a garment removed by a performer who goes on to shed everything

explanation.surface: Someone removes their jacket and then keeps going.
explanation.definitionFit: Paint remover takes off coats of paint, and a striptease artist sheds all clothing.

clue.text: Make rapid progress in a profession

explanation.definitionFit: To hurtle along at speed is one sense, and one's working life in a field is the other.
